name: Exchange ActiveSync
description: Windows MDM settings in the Exchange ActiveSync category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: EAS Sync Frequency (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to specify the number of minutes that Outlook automatically syncs the users' Exchange ActiveSync (EAS) accounts.

If you enable this policy setting, you can specify the number of minutes.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Outlook automatically syncs the users’ EAS accounts every 59 minutes.

properties.name: Enable Exchange ActiveSync account creation in the Outlook account setup UI (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting determines whether the Exchange ActiveSync button will be displayed in the account setup UI.

If you enable this policy setting, the Exchange ActiveSync button will be displayed in Outlook account setup UI.
